items.title: Nonstop
items.overview: Nonstop is a South Korean slice-of-life sitcom that broadcast its first season in 2000 on MBC. It continued with 5 more seasons. The series was popular for its cast of teen idols, many who debuted through the show..

items.title: Our Sticky Love
items.overview: An ambitious prosecutor loses her memory and moves in with a boxing coach who claims to be her boyfriend. Can this sticky situation turn into real love?

items.title: Mousetrap
items.overview: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

items.title: Teach You a Lesson
items.overview: An inspector from the Educational Rights Protection Bureau (ERPB) who is authorized by the government to use physical intervention and unconventional methods to discipline delinquent students and reform the educational system.

items.title: Squid Game
items.overview: Hundreds of cash-strapped players accept a strange invitation to compete in children's games. Inside, a tempting prize awaits — with deadly high stakes.

items.title: Weak Hero
items.overview: With the aid of unexpected friends, a gifted but introverted student confronts bullies and violent foes — unaware of how dangerous his world will become.

items.title: Agent Kim Reactivated
items.overview: When an unassuming dad's daughter goes missing, he dusts off his old black-ops skills to track her down — only to attract the wrong kind of attention.

items.title: Bloodhounds
items.overview: Faced with ruthless foes with a violent thirst, two young boxers band together — risking life and limb to bring justice and protect their loved ones.

items.title: A Shop for Killers
items.overview: A niece who lost her parents and grew up in the hands of an uncle who runs a shopping mall faces a new truth after her uncle's sudden death.

items.title: Four Hands, Two Sonatas
items.overview: When two young pianists from completely different worlds meet at an elite music high school, the melodies of their lives become intimately intertwined.

items.title: Dr. Romantic
items.overview: An eccentric, triple board-certified virtuoso surgeon leaves a top job in Seoul and ends up at a provincial hospital, where he mentors young doctors.

items.title: When Life Gives You Tangerines
items.overview: In Jeju, a spirited girl and a steadfast boy's island story blossoms into a lifelong tale of setbacks and triumphs — proving love endures across time.

items.title: My Demon
items.overview: A pitiless demon becomes powerless after getting entangled with an icy heiress, who may hold the key to his lost abilities — and his heart.

items.title: A Bona Fide Killer
items.overview: A seemingly ordinary working mother secretly lives as a legendary sniper who delivers justice where the law fails. items.title: Taxi Driver
items.overview: A former special forces soldier delivers revenge for victims of injustice while working for a secret organization that fronts as a taxi company.

items.title: All of Us Are Dead
items.overview: A high school becomes ground zero for a zombie virus outbreak. Trapped students must fight their way out — or turn into one of the rabid infected.

items.title: My Bias, My Boss
items.overview: A dedicated fangirl lands a job at a fashion company, only to discover it was co-founded by her ultimate idol. items.title: Marie and Her Three Daddies
items.overview: Kang Ma Ri has always longed for her father, but her search takes an unexpected turn when three men suddenly step into her life. This leads to the birth of an eccentric new family, one that proves stronger than blood and more persistent than DNA.

items.title: True Beauty
items.overview: After being bullied and discriminated because of her ugly looks, a high school girl transforms herself into a gorgeous "goddess" and quickly rises to fame after mastering the art of makeup via online tutorial videos.
